title: Build a full todo app in TypeScript — 4 turns
description: Four-turn todo app: turn 1 TodoList component, turn 2 add/remove, turn 3 filter/sort, turn 4 persistence and tests.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `addTodo(text)` in `src/useTodos.ts` — create a Todo with auto-incremented id, the given text, completed=false, and createdAt=Date.now(). Also compute `filteredAndSorted` — for now just return `todos` unfiltered. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to see where we stand. Now implement `removeTodo(id)`, `toggleTodo(id)`, and `clearCompleted()`. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.

Good. Now implement `filteredAndSorted`: apply the filter (all/active/completed) to todos, then sort by the sort order (newest=descending createdAt, oldest=ascending, alpha=alphabetical by text). Update setFilter and setSort to call their state setters. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.
Final push: run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any remaining failures. All 8 tests must pass — basic CRUD, filter, sort, and clearCompleted.
success_criteria: addTodo creates todo with all fields
